description: This file defines API routes related to report generation and download in a FastAPI-based backend. It contains endpoint functions for creating reports and downloading them, including route setup, request/response models, and exception handling.

methods.name: ReportResponse generate_report( req: ReportRequest, svc: ReportService = get_report_service, )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to generate a report based on provided dataset filename, columns to include, and format. It returns a report response object.

methods.name: FileResponse download_report( report_filename: str = Query(..., description="Report filename"), svc: ReportService = get_report_service, )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a previously generated report file by filename. It returns a file response for download.

ctags.name: download_report
ctags.signature: ( report_filename: str = Query(..., description="Report filename"), svc: ReportService = get_report_service, )
